content.short: Metrom is a liquidity mining platform for concentrated AMMs enabling precise, capital-efficient LP incentive distribution on Mantle.
content.description: Metrom is a specialized liquidity incentive platform allowing protocols to distribute rewards to targeted liquidity providers with precision, designed specifically for concentrated liquidity AMMs where rewards only go to LPs providing liquidity within specified price ranges. This makes incentive programs dramatically more capital efficient than traditional blanket liquidity mining. Officially recognized by Mantle Network, Metrom helps ecosystem protocols attract high-quality, sticky liquidity.
